b.inline: The Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People’s Republic of China

docTitle.inline: (Adopted at the Third Session of the Seventh National People’s Congress on April 4, 1990)

td.p: The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is an inalienable part of the People’s Republic of China.
The Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall be the head of the Region.
The Chief Executive shall be accountable to the Central People’s Government.

annex.p: Annex I hoort er niet bij.
